_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. aggroRadius 1.0 is the pre-merge zone radius verbatim and IS the interaction range (D7 ⇒ interaction.range omitted). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. The fire line, three grants deep (Torch/Ignite/Immolate) — the widest authored grant list and the one that pins the ordered stop-at-the-first-too-low walk.
name: Emberkeeper

lines: They burned this forest to hide their camp. Fire remembers who feeds it.

options.blockedLine: Fire doesn't suffer the careless. Grow stronger, then come to my flame.

grants.line: Let this be a light for you in dark places.
Let me show you how to light a fire in your enemies.
I can teach you how to burn everything around you. If you so desire.
